name: 92223 · Beaumont, CA
findings: ZIP 92223 (Beaumont) has 123 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92223 (Beaumont) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92223 (Beaumont) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).
